- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
szl is the SZL Holdings receipts layer for governed AI: signed
hash-chained receipts (khipu), the machine-checked Kamachikuna
constitution as callable gates, provenance badges, and two-axis
honesty routing. Stdlib-only; no runtime dependencies.
about.summary: The receipts layer for governed AI - khipu signing, the Kamachikuna constitution, provenance badges, and the two-axis Truth Router.

name: szl
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.7"
  python_min: "3.10"

package:
  name: szl
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/41/db/8919bf8fe7f8a1732a079d95adab1281aa18705f5d15f37f4143d52c7522/szl-0.1.7.tar.gz
  sha256: fcd581fc7ee24e577d18fedda9361fe1e2231bb30233b111a996203b77bf0e9e

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - szl
        - szl.kamachikuna
        - szl.khipu
        - szl.provenance
        - szl.router
        - szl.openshell
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "from szl import kamachikuna; assert kamachikuna.gate('x', True)[1] == 'ALLOWED'"
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://a-11-oy.com
  repository: https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-gpu-bridge
  documentation: https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-gpu-bridge/tree/main/sdk
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: The receipts layer for governed AI - khipu signing, the Kamachikuna constitution, provenance badges, and the two-axis Truth Router.
  description: |
    szl is the SZL Holdings receipts layer for governed AI: signed
    hash-chained receipts (khipu), the machine-checked Kamachikuna
    constitution as callable gates, provenance badges, and two-axis
    honesty routing. Stdlib-only; no runtime dependencies.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - stephenlutar2-hash
